notes.title: Patch 11.04.2020
notes.content:
Fixed a bug due to which many players were not given the Golden Baby achievement.
Thanks to one of the players for telling me personally about her. I apologize for such a long wait. Thank you for your support and patience.

notes.title: Release, Survival Mode and Steam Trading Cards!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32223376/dd0bbed0b488c4af0f65f74c8514688a92247af6.jpg[/img]

Hello! We've got for you especially good news, because today is release of Mother Simulator! We want to thank all the players for their support during our Early Access stage. Thank you so much! We couldn't have done it without all of you! 

There has been many changes to the game during last few months: 
[list]
    [*]We made 6 new levels; 
    [*]Training Mode has been added to all stages; 
    [*]We revised several game mechanics; 
    [*]Because of your help, we were able to find and fix many game bugs. 
[/list]

But today is not only our release date! Today new mode has been added to the game. It's called Survival. In this mode you must face all of the game challenges at once. The longer you play in Survival the harder it gets. Test your skill and find out how long you can hold out. 

But that's not all! We've got for you another small but pleasant surprise. Now Mother Simulator also has its own Steam Trading Cards! 

Thank you all once again! Good luck and have fun!

notes.title: Earthquake 2: Revenge
notes.content:
In this update, the following changes have been added:
[list]
    [*]A new level of earthquake with more difficult tasks,
    [*]The player's camera now does not pass through the walls,
    [*]Corrected the error with the display of the wrong medal in the main menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 7 May 2018
notes.content:
In this patch we made the following changes: 
[list]
    [*]Mouse inversion settings for X and Y axes has been added to option menu. 
    [*]Now the volume settings do not restart to default after you exit the game. 
    [*]We have revised the score system to add more accurate results on the record board. Now the values are stored in the database with an accuracy of two decimal places. This change will not affect current results. 
    [*]Now if you complete level in training mode, you will open the next level. Unfortunately, you will get only one point for completion.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 9 April 2018
notes.content:
Hello. In this update we added:
[list]
[*] A new level - "Voices of Animals" in which you have to play with your little one in Simon says
[*] Also we added a new task for wearing a baby in the arms
[*] Now every test can be started in training mode. In this mode, the timer will be disabled, but after passing the test without a timer the next one will not open
[*] Achievement for a new level
[*] Doors can now be opened without throwing out the baby
[*] Some objects have been replaced
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 2 April 2018
notes.content:
The volume settings for sounds in the Pause and Options menu have been added.
Corrected the bug with a stuck in the door when you open it.
Fixed several localization errors.
Now the cup and the nipple are visually correctly washed.
